Packages that use TaskStatus
Package
Description
io.mcs.taskmanager.entities
What is kept: the user's tasks, and the statuses a task moves through.
io.mcs.taskmanager.repositories
Spring Data repositories, each over one entity of entities.
io.mcs.taskmanager.services
What the app does with tasks, and the rules it does it under; the only callers of the repositories.
io.mcs.taskmanager.ui
The JavaFX front: DesktopApp, which starts Spring and opens the window; the window's controller, a Spring bean, with the task list, its filters and counts, and the search; the rows of the list; and the dialogs that open over it to add, edit and delete a task.
